reborn-1012.rationale: The legacy engine display text does not explicitly say 'target', while current official text does. The exact pinned Lua marks the Flip effect with EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET, selects one opponent-controlled monster with Duel.SelectTarget, takes control through the End Phase, and grants that successfully controlled monster direct-attack capability for the turn. The executable implementation therefore matches the current official targeting/control behavior even though the stale display wording does not fully express targeting.

reborn-0528.rationale: Current official text explicitly targets one face-up card whose effect negates Trap effects, while the legacy engine display text merely says to destroy one such face-up card. The exact pinned Lua sets EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET, uses Duel.SelectTarget, requires a face-up on-field card carrying the Double Snare marker effect, and destroys that target only if it remains face-up and related to the effect. The executable targeting behavior matches current official text.

note: Hash-bound implementation reviews for stale display text. Each row is additionally bound to the exact executable Lua SHA-256.
